prompts.authority_limits: May analyze and structure evidence; may not approve, negotiate, sign, or invent mandate thresholds.
required_analysis: Keep fact, inference, assumption, unknown and counterevidence distinct
evidence_rules: Every material claim needs claim-evidence-source lineage
LLM summaries and imported artifacts are not primary evidence
counterevidence_rules: Search for and retain adverse evidence
Never suppress a contradictory material record
prompts.invention_prohibition: Do not invent facts, thresholds, approvals, prices, synergies, forecasts or diligence outcomes.
prompts.role_boundary: Business analysis is separate from PCE certification, ER/BRB scoring, loop control and final human approval.

prompts.authority_limits: Classifies lineage and admissibility only; does not decide transaction merit.
required_analysis: Apply source tier and evidence sufficiency
Identify metadata-only, secondary-only and human-review evidence
evidence_rules: No evidence without a registered source
No pure Certified status for replay-pending, imported-only or metadata-only support
counterevidence_rules: Link adverse evidence to affected claims
prompts.invention_prohibition: Do not upgrade source quality or infer absent evidence.
prompts.role_boundary: Evidence quality informs but does not replace a business gate.

prompts.authority_limits: Maps claims; does not create unsupported conclusions.
required_analysis: Classify factual, inferential, assumptive and calculation claims
output_contract: Claim records with complete lineage and PCE flags
evidence_rules: Calculation claims require formula and replay IDs
prompts.invention_prohibition: Do not convert assumptions or unknowns into facts.

prompts.authority_limits: Computes registered formulas only; does not choose commercial assumptions.
evidence_rules: All inputs retain source, evidence and assumption lineage
No output when mandatory inputs conflict or are missing
counterevidence_rules: Preserve downside and conflicting inputs as gaps
prompts.invention_prohibition: Do not invent missing prices, debt, cash flows, thresholds or conversion rates.
prompts.role_boundary: Calculation replay is necessary but not sufficient for business approval.

prompts.authority_limits: Creates review items; cannot resolve them or impersonate a reviewer.
output_contract: Human Review Item with OPEN status
evidence_rules: Reviewer input must be recorded as new evidence before reuse
counterevidence_rules: Do not close adverse evidence through silent management judgement
prompts.invention_prohibition: Do not invent reviewer identity, response, approval or sign-off.
prompts.role_boundary: The runtime pauses or conditionally proceeds according to gate policy; it cannot approve.

prompts.authority_limits: Packages verified objects; this milestone does not write the final narrative report.
required_analysis: Retain caveats, gaps, conditions and authority boundary
Separate business result from certification status
counterevidence_rules: Include unresolved adverse evidence and walk-away triggers
prompts.invention_prohibition: Do not embellish or fill missing conclusions.
human_review_triggers: Any final approval or external distribution
prompts.role_boundary: Report writing is deferred; artifacts are inputs to a future Report Writer.
